card.name: Units and slashes after numbers
card.fires_on: The word right after a number in dosing tables and formulas, such as mL, mg, MBq, x, or a slash in regulation numbers like 2173/2005. It also fires on one name split mid-word (Morell|The|obald).

modes.label: Unit after number
modes.description: A measure such as mL, mg or MBq directly after a figure in a dose table or calculation.

modes.label: Slash in regulation number
modes.description: The slash between number and year in EU regulation citations.
modes.example: A new regulation (2010) The European Parliament and the Council have adopted a new regulation: Regulation (EU) No 995<</>>2010 of the European Parliament

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot just after a number where a unit, multiplication sign, or slash comes next in dose tables and legal citations.
